preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access the mint function

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) function to mint tokens directly to the attacker's address. This bypasses normal token distribution mechanisms and allows the owner to arbitrarily increase their token balance, which can be used to manipulate reward allocations in associated MasterChef staking contracts. The mint function is protected by onlyOwner modifier, so only the owner can execute this attack.
